title: RewardHarness: Self-Evolving Agentic Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.08703v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Aligning generative models with human preferences remains a central challenge. While RLHF is widely adopted, it relies on large-scale preference data. This limitation is particularly evident in evaluating instruction-guided image edits, even though humans can often learn such preferences from only a few examples. We present RewardHarness, a training-free, self-evolving agentic reward framework that reframes reward modeling as context evolution rather than weight optimization. Instead of learning from large-scale annotations, RewardHarness aligns with human preferences by iteratively evolving a library of tools and skills from as few as 100 preference demonstrations. Given a source image, an edited image, and an editing instruction, an orchestrator agent selects the most relevant subset of tools and skills from the maintained library, and sub-agents invoke them to construct a reasoning chain that produces a reward score. translated_title: RewardHarness：自进化的智能体后训练框架
translated_abstract: 将生成式模型与人类偏好对齐仍然是一个核心挑战。虽然RLHF被广泛采用，但它依赖于大规模的偏好数据。这一局限性在评估指令引导的图像编辑时尤为明显，尽管人类通常只需少量示例就能学会此类偏好。我们提出了RewardHarness，这是一个无需训练、自我进化的智能体奖励框架，它将奖励建模重新定义为上下文演化而非权重优化。RewardHarness无需从大规模标注中学习，而是通过从少至100个偏好示例中迭代演化一个工具与技能库来与人类偏好对齐。给定源图像、编辑后的图像和编辑指令，一个协调器智能体从维护的库中选择最相关的工具和技能子集，子智能体调用它们构建推理链，从而产生奖励分数。通过比较……
tldr: RewardHarness是一个无需训练、自进化的智能体奖励框架，将奖励建模从权重优化转变为上下文演化，仅需100个偏好示例即可通过迭代演化工具与技能库实现与人类偏好的对齐，用于评估指令引导的图像编辑。
en_tdlr: RewardHarness is a training-free, self-evolving agentic reward framework that reframes reward modeling as context evolution rather than weight optimization, aligning with human preferences from as few as 100 preference demonstrations by iteratively evolving a library of tools and skills for evaluating instruction-guided image edits.
